name: king-day-catalogue
description: KING DAY - Kids Products E-Commerce Catalogue Website and Admin Panel

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.start: npx prisma db push && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && node server/dist/index.js
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npx prisma generate
